_comment: Stage-2 DiT training on pre-encoded latents of the CONSTRUCTED dataset. Point 'path' at the pre_encode_4ch.py output dir for this dataset. Each latent's metadata carries prompt/text + spatial_format + seconds_total. Synth clips are 4-10s, so latent_crop_length 432 (~10s @ ds1024/44.1k, chosen VAE = ds1024_z64) keeps full clips.
